whatThisPluginAdds.text: Site Stats registers privacy-safe current-day page and site totals with Capell's typed metrics pipeline.

surfaceOutcome.text: Authorized global administrators can inspect retained content-inventory trends through a consuming Core metrics surface without collecting visitor analytics.

developers.text: The collector uses Core metric definitions, scopes, governance, and daily rollups rather than introducing a package-specific reporting store.

teams.text: Teams get a simple retained view of content growth without page-view tracking, request logging, or a second analytics dashboard.
